name: prompt-362
image_vibe: Confident black tailoring in a refined white interior with quiet cinematic elegance
image_purpose: Create a polished fashion lookbook portrait for luxury editorial use.

prompt.project_info: A cinematic studio portrait of an original adult woman in a black suit seated on a white luxury chair.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman wearing a black suit with a composed confident expression and a graceful natural silhouette. She sits elegantly with her right hand beneath her chin, chin slightly raised, head subtly tilted right, and eyes looking forward.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject seated on a luxurious white chair as the main focal point, pure white background with a rare art painting, a unique white table beside the chair holding a black coffee cup and stylish lamp decor, and refined balanced negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-quality cinematic studio lighting with soft controlled illumination on the face and suit, subtle shadows, clean white environment, refined elegant luxury mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic fashion portrait, 85mm lens, f/4, realistic skin, tailoring, chair, table, ceramic cup, lamp, and artwork texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic photorealistic studio portrait of an original adult woman wearing a black suit and seated elegantly on a luxurious white chair. Place her right hand gently beneath her chin, chin slightly raised, head subtly tilted to the right, and eyes looking forward with quiet confidence. Use a pure white background featuring a rare art painting, and place a unique white table beside the chair with a black coffee cup and stylish lamp decor. Use soft controlled cinematic studio lighting, subtle shadows, realistic skin, tailoring, chair, table, ceramic, lamp, and artwork texture, an 85mm lens at f/4, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution luxury editorial clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed chair, floating objects, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source black-suit white-chair portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for black suit, white chair and table, hand-under-chin pose, art painting, coffee cup, lamp, and white luxury setting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult subject, black suit, white chair, hand-under-chin pose, white table with cup and lamp, artwork, and refined cinematic mood. Identity and non-essential details may vary.
